notices.title: The bench now listens on this computer only
notices.text: The web server and socketio of a bench now accept connections from this computer only (127.0.0.1). Before, they listened on every interface, so anyone on your Wi-Fi could reach the dev server and its debugger. A bench that is running keeps listening on every interface until you run `benchbar repair` and then `benchbar restart` (`benchbar doctor` shows `Procfile.lean is outdated`). If you open the bench from a phone or another PC by this computer's address, run `benchbar listen all` to switch back; `benchbar listen local` undoes it. On Windows, http://SITE.localhost:8000 keeps working.

notices.title: An option a command does not take is now an error
notices.text: An option a command does not take now stops the run with exit 64 and changes nothing. Before, it was ignored and the command ran: `benchbar repair --dry-rn --yes` ran for real. If a script of yours passes options a command never read, remove them. To go back for now, set BENCHBAR_LENIENT_FLAGS=1: an unknown option is then a warning on stderr and the command runs, as before. A flag that needs a value and has none stays an error.

notices.title: benchbar pull now neutralises the copy
notices.text: benchbar pull now neutralises the copy: integrations are switched off and stored passwords are deleted, except the Administrator login. A copy you already pulled keeps what it has until you pull again with --replace. Add --keep-secrets to keep production's integrations and passwords in the copy, as before.
